meaning: The intuitionist theory (bundle TruthCore.Comparison.ExcludedMiddle.Intuitionist, four commitments from the pinned SEP witness) entails withholding excluded middle without denying it: the assertion rule for p ∨ ¬p, an instance not asserted at some stage, and every denial refuted. Withholding is derived from the theory's own account of assertion and proof, so the rival does not win by subtraction. Truth as provability (STMT-TRUTH-IS-PROVABILITY-INTUITIONISM) is not in the bundle: it is the comparison's open premise for Q-TRUTH and is not used here.
